chunks: Ayyūb ibn Rāshid narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
"The withholder of zakat will be encircled by a bald snake that eats from his brain.
And that is the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'They will be encircled by what they were stingy with on the Day of Resurrection.'

key_terms.بَخِلُوا: they were stingy or withheld miserly
key_terms.مَانِعُ: one who withholds or refuses to give

ai.seo_question: What happens to the one who refuses to pay zakat according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that withholding zakat brings a severe punishment in the Hereafter. The Imam عليه السلام explains the Quranic phrase as a real torment in which the miser is encircled by what he withheld on the Day of Resurrection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1585 - Ayyub ibn Rashid reported from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
"The one who withholds Zakat will be encircled by a bald snake that will eat from his brain.
This is the meaning of Allah’s (swt) statement: 'They will be encircled by what they withheld on the Day of Resurrection' (Surah Ali ‘Imran 3:180)."
